records.text: The National Counterterrorism Center was stopped from continuing to investigate Tyler Robinson as a possible lone gunman, despite remaining linkages that needed investigation.
records.speaker: Joe Kent

appearances.snippet: We've been told that this individual, Robinson, is a lone gunman and maybe he is. But the investigation that I was a part of, the National Counterterrorism Center was a part of, we were stopped from continuing to investigate.

verification.notes: Transcript context correctly captures Joe Kent's firsthand account. In a later March 20 interview he again said NCTC had additional leads to investigate but further work was not done after the FBI deferred to Utah. No released internal NCTC/FBI records independently corroborate his account, so confidence is medium.
